body.name: Exactly normalized shared-design global-shift marked family
body.construction: Fix \(d=n\), \(\sigma=\sigma_n^\star\), \(h\in\{-1,1\}\), and \(z\in\mathcal Z_n\). Define \(P_{h,z}^\star\) by \(p_k=1/n\), \(\pi_k=1/2\), and \(\tau_k=h\Delta_n^\star+(M\sigma_n^\star/2)z_k\). Set \(\mu_{ak}=(2a-1)\tau_k/2\). Conditional on \(X=k\), draw \(A\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\); independently draw each \(Y(a)\in\{-M/2,M/2\}\) with \(P\{Y(a)=M/2\mid X=k\}=1/2+(2a-1)\tau_k/(2M)\), and set \(Y=Y(A)\). Let \(\Pi_h^\star\) be uniform over \(\{P_{h,z}^\star:z\in\mathcal Z_n\}\). Every support law is exactly normalized, has the same deterministic design \((p_k,\pi_k)=(1/n,1/2)\), satisfies \(\tau(P_{h,z}^\star)=h\Delta_n^\star\), and obeys \(\max_k|\tau_k-\tau(P_{h,z}^\star)|\le M\sigma_n^\star/2\).
